research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Iterable is researching machine learning techniques for predicting actions and behavior, where a training engine and explanatory engine help specify predictive goals and generate explanatory data for model outputs. It is also developing techniques for segmenting users based on behaviors across electronic channels, transmitting messages subject to multiple rate limits, and scaling workflow campaigns. Together these efforts target behavioral prediction, user segmentation, message delivery control, and campaign orchestration.

overview_description.description: Iterable is the AI-powered communication platform that organizations trust to build deeper customer relationships through personalized, real-time engagement. With Iterable, leading brands like Priceline, Fabletics, Blockchain, and Box deliver seamless cross-channel experiences by turning data into action and continuously optimizing for maximum impact. Because the future of marketing isn’t about sending more campaigns—it’s about creating moments that matter. Learn more at www.iterable.com.
